scope: Project-owned immutable byte-source and availability contracts from ADR 0035. Independent literal byte vectors test storage and ownership, without invoking a PDF parser or product writer as an oracle.

requirements.status: source storage implemented; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: Document parser/cache migration, progressive opening/pages, jobs, encoding, protocol and scheduling remain group 11 obligations.
requirements.rule: A source fixes identity and length. Supplies validate all overlaps before publishing new fragments. Missing bytes remain separate from terminal errors. Duplicate bytes do not advance availability; conflicting overlap invalidates future reads. Every retained allocation stays charged until its last lease drops. Assembly and missing-range frontiers obey explicit caps, and work accumulates across retries.
